en.headline: Police arrest 123 in phone scam and money laundering operation
en.dek: The Commercial Crime Bureau and districts cracked 108 cases involving about HK$68 million and raided two industrial building call centres in Hung Hom and Kwun Tong.
body: Police have arrested 123 people in an operation targeting telephone scams and related money laundering that began earlier this month.

Officers from the Commercial Crime Bureau and multiple districts detected 108 cases involving about HK$68 million. They raided two industrial building units in Hung Hom and Kwun Tong that served as scam call centres and seized automatic dialling equipment.

Most of those arrested were mule account holders or people who registered phone numbers used in the scams. Police charged them with conspiracy to defraud, obtaining property by deception and money laundering. Those held ranged in age from 14 to 75.

Police said telephone scams accounted for about 30 percent of all fraud cases in the first three quarters of the year, with losses reaching HK$1.9 billion. Common methods involved impersonating customer service staff from retailers or platforms and asking victims to transfer money to verify identity.
Investigators noted that some scam calls originated from internet phone systems that appeared as fixed-line numbers, and they urged telecom operators to strengthen customer checks.

zh.headline: 警方打擊電話騙案及洗黑錢拘123人
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科聯同各警區偵破108宗案件涉款約6800萬元，搞破紅磡及觀塘兩間工廈詐騙電話操作中心。
body: 警方本月展開打擊電話騙案及相關洗黑錢行動，拘123人。
商業罪案調查科聯同多個警區共偵破108宗騙案，涉及款項約6800萬元。行動搞破兩個分別位於紅磡及觀塘工廈單位的詐騙電話操作中心，並檢獲自動撥號設備。
被捕人士年齡介乎14至75歲，大部分是洗黑錢戶口的傀儱戶口持有人或詐騙電話登記人。警方以涉嫌串謀詐騙、以欺騙手段取得財產及洗黑錢罪拘捕他們。
警方指，今年首三季電話騙案接近1萬宗，佔整體詐騙案三成，損失金額達19億元。常見手法為假冒零售商或購物平台客服，訛稱貨品或服務有問題可獲賠償，再以驗證身份為由誘騙轉帳。
調查發現部分詐騙電話由網絡電話打出並偽裝成固網號碼。警方呼籲電訊商加強客戶審核，防止騙徒利用相關號碼行騙。
